briefs.claim_en: The image in this post shows people celebrating India's Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landing near the Moon's south pole.
briefs.brief_en: India's Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft successfully landed on the Moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, making India the first country to achieve this feat. This historic event was met with widespread celebrations across India, as reported by The Guardian, Rediff.com, and Indian Express. Celebrations included cheering, hugging, waving the national flag, distributing sweets, dancing, and setting off firecrackers. People gathered in various locations, including educational institutions, offices, city squares, and religious places, to watch the live telecast of the landing. A LinkedIn post also directly links an image to the Chandrayaan-3 landing celebrations.
